purpose: Find current authority and diagnostic wisdom for a fresh native reconciliation task without loading the full memory head.
authority: Local process policy; source hints are routes, not proof of completion or peer authority.
method: Try declared source routes first; verify locators and current bytes.
Read the packet sources before querying the semantic index.
If routes are absent or insufficient, make at most one MemPalace search per packet with limit 3; verify returned sources within that packet’s remaining file/byte budget.
Treat service ranking as candidate discovery, not authority; it may combine semantic and lexical scores. Record query, source locators and unknown ranking/version details.

If useful evidence does not fit this packet, report its unresolved frontier. Autonomously open another focused packet with an explicit evidence question when expected value justifies it; carry cumulative cost forward and do not reset accounting to conceal repeated fruitless searches.

An open with no --intent adopts the caller's own --need as the session intent: the question the agent actually carried is what every later operation, receipt and finish is accounted against. An explicit --intent still wins.
Use native scoped reconciliation for current evidence; never infer acceptance from a test, date, similarity score or checkbox.

Clean adjacent evidence-backed issues in flight. Continue successive batches while useful authorized work remains; no one-item ceremony cap. Preserve independent verification and genuine authority boundaries.

Current native evidence is read in-process by the executor itself: the concern, context and reconciliation projections are calls, not a second process, so there is no separate executable to pin and no second stderr budget. Oversized or missing projections are refused. Record native output separately from source-file bytes.

The tooling layer is inside scope: .claude/ (skills, hooks, commands, agents, epr-meta, scripts, workflows, memory) is a declared source root, because a surface an agent must recall and cannot read through the entry is read outside it and goes unmetered. Two subtrees stay refused inside it: the private recall store .eprfs/status/recall/ and .claude/worktrees/, a sibling checkout that is not this repository's declared source.

Use one --session across CLI calls and an explicit --need each time. The executor pins algorithm bytes, charges cumulative operations and refuses oversized output. Discover returns metadata candidates; --lines reads an explicit bounded excerpt. External shell/MCP reads are outside enforcement.

The initial native-reconciliation packet supplies usage and causal context; its growing plan is an explicit follow-up route, read by selected excerpt or native scope rather than silently widening the initial packet.
freshness: Fingerprint each source using the existing canonical body convention.
Check the verified CLI named in the usage source before a current-evidence query.
Check index currency when using MemPalace; stale retrieval may suggest a source but cannot establish current behavior.
No unconditional search, taxonomy load or diary writes. Mutation needs explicit maintenance authority.

questions: Where is authoritative current doorway evidence, and does technical review establish acceptance?
How is an exact actor claim registered and retained by flow claim?
What causal lesson prevents green processes or tests from being mistaken for delivery?
record: tokens if actually metered; otherwise unknown
subsequent implementation rework if observed; otherwise unknown
evaluation.acceptance: Independent reader judges answer fitness. Budget compliance alone is not semantic correctness or stasis.

native-reconciliation.query: native reconciliation independent acceptance actor claim

budget_scope: Each packet bounds a context load, not the number of issues or batches a ceremony may complete. Track cumulative usage and resolved work across packets.

governance.retire_when: native EPR execution supplies equivalent verified discovery, limits and session continuity
governance.authority_boundary: Local EPRFS-sealed authored content; no new core kind, publication or peer authority.

lens_table.revealed_rule: a reader tier whose last 3 journeys reached authority at level L is offered the next level; a tier with a mistaken assertion in its last 3 is offered the previous level

discovery.unreadable_candidates: A candidate whose frontmatter does not parse is SKIPPED, COUNTED and NAMED — never silently dropped, and never a reason to abandon the rest of the traversal. The view carries an omissions line naming the skipped paths (first 8, then a remainder count) and a frontier entry `unreadable candidates: N`, so a reader learns exactly what the window could not read. Aborting the whole scan on the first unparseable document satisfied the same honesty rule and made the returned window useless.
discovery.body_scan_window: limits.body_scan_bytes (65536) is the per-file window term discovery may read for MATCHING, and it is spent only when there is a query or terms to match; a pure tag filter still reads limits.metadata_bytes. The frontmatter read stays metadata_bytes and byte-exact — a wider body window never widens what establishes membership. limits.scan_bytes (2097152) and scan_seconds (5) bound the traversal as a whole, so a scope the size of .claude/skills is one call. Every byte read here is charged to the scan counters, never to source_bytes: discovery is not evidence, and an excerpt receipt is still the only thing that quotes a document. A candidate larger than the window is scanned to it and COUNTED — the omissions line says how many were only partially scanned — because a term past the window is invisible, which is not evidence of its absence.
discovery.bounded_prefix_match: Query terms are matched against the declared frontmatter AND the body bytes the SAME bounded read already covered (limits.body_scan_bytes per file when matching) — no second read and no wider budget. Each candidate reports where its terms were found (path, title, description, tag, body); a declared hit scores twice a body hit ON THE SAME TERM, so frontmatter outranks body without letting one hit on a word every document shares outrank several hits on the words that name the concern. A body hit BEYOND the per-file prefix is invisible to discovery and is not evidence of absence.
discovery.boundary_cut_is_not_a_parse_failure: A bounded read routinely ends mid-character. The tail is trimmed back to the last complete UTF-8 boundary before parsing; the frontmatter header itself is still exact bytes, and a trim landing before the closing delimiter reports an unproven boundary rather than a malformed document. Condemning a file because the budget cut a multibyte character is a fault of the reader, not the document.
discovery.semantic_output: unverified provider text; exact tag filtering requires source metadata

ceremony.purpose: Reconcile a concern so the next agent can act from current evidence without losing purpose or concealing uncertainty.
ceremony.finish: A reviewed, evidence-backed outcome addressing the intent and an explicit unresolved frontier, standing on either per-edge reconciliation (the ceremony door) or the inspected passages alone (the focused door, which reconciles no edge and says so). Responsible stopping is valid.

guiding_context.value: Sacred Attention: correct decisions and preserved uncertainty before byte savings
Governed views select assertions and share evidence without creating another queue

ceremony.authored_by: agent:orchestrator@gpt-6 under the recorded operator direction; local attribution only
ceremony.change_authority: Existing repository governance applies. Operator authorization permits this implementation. Substantive ceremony rewrites use existing approval; normative holds require explicit operator confirmation.
permitted_changes: explicit scope, page, concern or evidence question
version the recipe under existing source governance; resume with prior receipt retained
ceremony.passage_location: Discovery locates a PASSAGE, not only a document. When the session carries a need, an outline annotates each section with the need-term occurrences inside it and offers a read range bounded to limits.source_bytes, top-hit sections first; a section larger than one excerpt is offered as its first window and named as such. A focused candidate carries the section its terms land in, and its linked choice reads that range rather than the file head. Naming a document whose headings answer nothing is half an answer, and the reader pays the other half in guesses.
ceremony.selection: Native stale/dangling edge projection; stable native slot order, grouped by upstream source. Drift is not a substantive judgment.
omissions: Only the declared scope and returned page are shown.
No semantic ranking quality, whole-corpus acceptance or peer authority is implied.
Whole-harness context and tokens remain unmetered.
dependencies: native EPR context/edges/reconciliation and current local records
bounded recall executor and exact source excerpts
existing flow review, appointment and acceptance admission

local.ranking: deterministic metadata traversal; no semantic relevance ranking
local.restrictions: declared source scope and scan/output budgets

mempalace.restrictions: installed local executable and existing palace; candidates require source verification

ceremony.continuation: Local receipt stores intent, selected edge, evidence and unresolved questions. Native judgments are re-read; continuation is not a work queue or approval.
ceremony.acceptance: Independent technical review then appointed fresh agent exercises the final entry and records exact revision/environment/evidence/limits.

measurements.owner: EPRFS governed evidence; deterministic footprint lens
measurements.scope_rule: Explicit --measure-scope wins at entry; otherwise ceremony scope, with declared default cohort for repository-wide ceremonies. Resume retains the original scope.
measurements.pairing: Explicit pinned baseline and close in the continuation; incompatible or incomplete evidence refuses comparison; costs do not grade ceremony judgment.

collective_memory.owner: Repository collective; existing actor store owns local attribution, not authenticated membership
collective_memory.input: --memory-input names an explicit governed request file; use native collective view for contracts
collective_memory.graduation: Read-only local repository reach rehearsal, never publication
collective_memory.native_memory: Legacy Claude memory path is already symlinked into tracked .claude/memory; no private/shared migration is claimed.
